chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Al-Amraki ibn Ali, from Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), said:
I asked him about the deceased, 'Can he be washed in the open?' He said: 'There is no problem, and if he were to be veiled with a curtain, it is more beloved to me.'

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem / it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to wash the deceased in an open area according to Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies that while washing the deceased in an open area (al-fada') is legally valid, covering the body with a curtain is preferred (ahabb) to preserve modesty (hayā') during the ritual. This ruling reflects the Shia juristic emphasis on balancing ritual purity with dignity, distinguishing between strict obligation and recommended etiquette in funeral rites.
